legend: The king wants to create an artificial island with the following properties: it must be a simple, non-self-intersecting polygon with n$$$n$$$ vertices, all vertices having integer coordinates, no three consecutive vertices lying on the same line, the lengths of all edges being integers, and no edge being parallel to any of the coordinate axes. Given the number n$$$n$$$, construct such an island with coordinates that do not exceed an absolute value of 104$$$10^4$$$.
input: The first and only line contains one integer n$$$n$$$ (3≤n≤30$$$3 \leq n \leq 30$$$).
output: Output n$$$n$$$ lines, each containing two integers xi$$$x_i$$$, yi$$$y_i$$$ (−10000≤xi,yi≤10000$$$-10\,000 \leq x_i, y_i \leq 10\,000$$$) — the coordinates of the i$$$i$$$-th vertex. The vertices should be output in a clockwise or counterclockwise order.

legend.ai: 国王想要建造一个具有以下性质的人工岛：它必须是一个具有 n$$$n$$$ 个顶点的简单不自交多边形，所有顶点的坐标均为整数，任意三个相邻顶点不在同一直线上，所有边的长度均为整数，并且没有任何边平行于坐标轴。给定数字 n$$$n$$$，构造这样一个岛，使其坐标的绝对值不超过 104$$$10^4$$$。

input.ai: 第一行且仅有一行包含一个整数 n$$$n$$$(3≤n≤30$$$3 \leq n \leq 30$$$)。

output.ai: 输出 n$$$n$$$ 行，每行包含两个整数 xi$$$x_i$$$、yi$$$y_i$$$(−10000≤xi,yi≤10000$$$-10\,000 \leq x_i, y_i \leq 10\,000$$$)——第 i$$$i$$$ 个顶点的坐标。顶点应按顺时针或逆时针顺序输出。
